SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-12: CQL - String Operators. Test these items: Combine, Concatenate, EndsWith, Indexer, LastPositionOf, Length, Lower, Matches, PositionOf, ReplaceMatches, Split, SplitOnMatches, StartsWith, Substring, Upper. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.title: CombineSep used DuckDB's comma default for null separators
issues.evidence: Combine({'a','b'}, null) returned 'a,b' because array_to_string(list, NULL) uses a comma separator in DuckDB. CQL Combine with a null separator should use the default empty separator.
issues.fix: Updated CombineSep to pass COALESCE(sep, '') to array_to_string while preserving NULL for null/all-null lists.
issues.verification: Covered by translated and direct no-Python/browser-style string parity tests.

issues.title: Derived string indexers lowered through list extraction
issues.evidence: Expressions such as Combine({'a','b'})[2], ReplaceMatches('abc','b','x')[3], and Last(Split('ab/cd','/'))[2] were treated as list indexers and returned empty strings at the boundary instead of NULL.
issues.fix: Expanded the string-index source classifier to recognize Combine, ReplaceMatches, Replace, and Last over Split/SplitOnMatches or string lists, and route those sources through the CQL Indexer macro.
issues.verification: Covered by focused string operator parity tests across forced Python fallback, native-loaded DuckDB, and no-Python/browser-style direct SQL surfaces.

issues.title: CQL ampersand concatenation incorrectly null-propagated
issues.evidence: Translated null & 'b', 'a' & null, and null & null lowered to SQL || and returned NULL. CQL & treats null operands as empty strings.
issues.fix: Lowered operator '&' to COALESCE(left, '') || COALESCE(right, '') while leaving Concatenate as the null-propagating operator.
issues.verification: Covered by translated parity tests on forced Python fallback and native-loaded DuckDB registrations.

issues.title: Regex-backed string operators lacked advanced regex parity across public surfaces
issues.evidence: Direct public calls such as Matches('aa', '(.)\1'), Matches('ab', '(?=b)'), ReplaceMatches('book', '(.)\1', 'X'), and SplitOnMatches('ab', '(?=b)') failed or diverged between native C++ and Python fallback paths.
issues.fix: Added cqlRegexMatches, cqlRegexReplaceMatches, and cqlRegexSplitOnMatches helper UDFs in Python fallback and native C++ code; string macros now call those helpers to preserve single-line mode, backreferences, lookahead, global replacement, CQL replacement capture semantics, and ReDoS guarding.
issues.verification: Covered by focused string parity tests, no-Python/browser-style direct SQL probes, native C++ CQL unittest, official CQL conformance, full conformance, and full fhir4ds pytest.
